steps.title: This is Wraith
steps.body: We're showing private payments on Stellar testnet. Click Connect Wallet to start.

steps.title: Wallet keys stay local
steps.body: We just asked your wallet to sign a stealth-key derivation message. These keys live in your browser, not on any server.

steps.title: Choose a private recipient
steps.body: Paste any Stellar stealth meta-address here, or type a .wraith name.

steps.title: Set the XLM amount
steps.body: Enter an XLM amount. We'll generate a fresh stealth address, so the recipient's real address never appears on-chain.

steps.title: Send privately
steps.body: When you send, the network sees a transfer to a new address that nobody can link to the recipient. Try it on testnet.
